metadata.title: Secure-Device Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan establishing the Secure-Device Platform as the authoritative trust and execution framework for cyber-physical and connected devices.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits the Secure-Device composite pattern and governs how foundational device execution, control, and safety patterns are interpreted across the institution.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure-Device Platform defines institutional expectations for device execution, identity, integrity, lifecycle, command handling, change, access, segmentation, and safety. It applies to all devices capable of executing instructions that affect the physical or operational environment.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Authoritative trust plane governing execution of cyber-physical and connected devices.

props.name: trust-model
props.remarks: Device trust is derived from identity, integrity, lifecycle, command, telemetry, and safety signals; it is contextual and revocable.

props.name: implicit-authorization
props.remarks: Device identity, attestation, connectivity, or command validity must not be interpreted as authorization or safety approval.

props.name: execution-impact-awareness
props.remarks: All device execution is assumed to have real-world impact and must be treated accordingly.

props.name: safety-precedence-model
props.remarks: Safety precedence is enforced via overlays (e.g., OT, IoMT) and not assumed at the foundational layer.

props.name: lifecycle-revocation
props.remarks: Device trust may be degraded or revoked based on lifecycle state, integrity loss, or safety context.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure-Device Platform is implemented by composing foundational device execution patterns with domain-specific safety overlays. This SSPP does not authorize commands, approve changes, or assert regulatory compliance.

roles.title: Device Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines Secure-Device execution architecture, trust semantics, and SSPP inheritance.

roles.title: Device Security Governance
roles.remarks: Approves device trust policies, safety overlay applicability, risk tolerances, and lifecycle revocation criteria.

roles.title: Device Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates device fleets and infrastructure in accordance with Secure-Device trust and safety expectations.

roles.title: Device Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors device execution integrity, lifecycle violations, command misuse, and safety-relevant signals.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are satisfied through inheritance from Secure-Device patterns and downstream SSPPs. This Platform SSPP does not restate control implementations.
